## D.3 Persistence authority audit

```text
For every durable field record:

FIELD
WRITER
CANONICAL STORE
GENERATION / CHECKSUM
CHECKPOINT ORDER
READER
RESTART PATH
RECONCILIATION RULE
CANARY

Audit at minimum:
WorkUnit state
Goal/DAG
backend_task_id
provider/runtime provenance
dependencies
verifier result
repair lineage
retry state
mutation lease
steering
context calibration
MAX calibration
backend health
checkpoint generation
background jobs
VMCP evidence references
ModelLake worker identity
```

A crash must recover one coherent generation or the previous coherent generation, never a random hybrid. Use atomic replacement/generation IDs/checksums as appropriate.

ModelLake worker identity.reconciliation_rule: worker identity is a receipt, not a WorkUnit field

VMCP evidence references.reconciliation_rule: VMCP is evidence, not work identity
VMCP evidence references.restart_path: receipt reread, not reconstructed from model output

WorkUnit state.reconciliation_rule: DAG is authoritative; state.json is the fallback copy

backend health.reconciliation_rule: stale open older than HEALTH_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS does not refuse work

backend_task_id.reconciliation_rule: adopt if live, fail if terminal, else interrupt

background jobs.reconciliation_rule: same job_id, never a silent second supervisor

checkpoint generation.reconciliation_rule: crash between writes: recover the DAG generation, never a zip of both

context calibration.canonical_store: not a dedicated durable file; compiled IR is in mission/state.json
context calibration.writer: Mission.context_memory is in-process; unit context is compiled at dispatch

mutation lease.reconciliation_rule: exactly one live holder; dead pid is breakable
mutation lease.restart_path: try_break_stale if holder pid is dead

provider/runtime provenance.reconciliation_rule: provider is execution policy, persisted so restart does not reroute

repair lineage.reconciliation_rule: disk floor wins over in-process maps

steering.reconciliation_rule: steer changes future work, not verified history

verifier result.reconciliation_rule: ok:true is the only completing outcome

notes: Catalog symbol MutationLock: O_EXCL+os.link exclusive create. Two processes cannot both hold it (measured).
hcli.persist.atomic_write_text is the crash-safe writer (tmp + fsync + os.replace).
WorkUnit state has one authoritative store (dag.json); state.json is a stamped copy.
